access.wordGroup: {user} is asking for access to the group {item}
access.groupCollection: {user} is asking for access to the collection {item}

contribution.wordGroup: {user} is asking to contribute to the group {item}
contribution.groupCollection: {user} is asking to contribute to the collection {item}

access.wordGroup: {name} will have access to the group “{item}” and can export its words. You can remove their access at any time.
access.groupCollection: {name} will have access to the collection “{item}” and can export its words. You can remove their access at any time.

contribution.wordGroup: {name} will be able to contribute to the group “{item}”. You can withdraw this permission at any time.
contribution.groupCollection: {name} will be able to contribute to the collection “{item}”. You can withdraw this permission at any time.

management.label: Access
management.loadFailed: The access list could not be loaded.
management.noMembers: Nobody but you for now. Send the invitation link to receive requests.

access.wordGroup: {name} will no longer have access to this group. They can ask you for access again with the share link.
access.groupCollection: {name} will no longer have access to this collection. They can ask you for access again with the share link.

contribution.wordGroup: {name} will no longer be able to contribute to this group. Their contributions are kept, and they can ask you for permission again.
contribution.groupCollection: {name} will no longer be able to contribute to this collection. Their contributions are kept, and they can ask you for permission again.

description.access: People who open this link can ask you for access. You will accept or refuse each request.
description.contribution: People who open this link can ask you to contribute. You will accept or refuse each request.

link.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the link and copy it.
link.regenerated: New link created. The old one no longer works.
link.regenerateWarning: The old link will no longer work. Continue?

invalid.title: Invalid link
invalid.description: This share link does not exist or is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.

invitation.loadFailed: The share could not be loaded.

membersOnly.wordGroup: Everyone can view it, but only the people allowed by {name} can contribute to it.
membersOnly.groupCollection: Everyone can view it, but only the people allowed by {name} can contribute to it.

sent.access: Access request sent. You will receive an email as soon as {name} has handled it.
sent.contribution: Contribution request sent. You will receive an email as soon as {name} has handled it.

invitation.refused: Your previous request was refused. You can send a new one.

description.wordGroup: This person adds words, and only edits or deletes their own.
description.groupCollection: This person adds groups, and only removes the ones they added.

description.wordGroup: This person also edits and deletes other people’s words, yours included.
description.groupCollection: This person also removes the groups added by others, you included.

note.wordGroup: These rights only apply while the group is open to contributions. The group’s name, visibility, sharing and deletion stay with you.
note.groupCollection: These rights only apply while the collection is open to contributions. The collection’s name, visibility, sharing and deletion stay with you.

help.wordGroup: With a partial sharing, the person adds words and only edits or deletes their own. With a full sharing, they can also edit and delete other people’s, yours included. These rights only apply while the group is open to contributions.
help.groupCollection: With a partial sharing, the person adds groups and only removes the ones they added. With a full sharing, they can also remove other people’s, yours included. These rights only apply while the collection is open to contributions.

partial.wordGroup: {name} will only be able to edit and delete their own words. They will be notified by email if they turned it on.
partial.groupCollection: {name} will only be able to remove the groups they added. They will be notified by email if they turned it on.

full.wordGroup: {name} will be able to edit and delete every word of the group, yours included, while it is open to contributions. They will be notified by email if they turned it on.
full.groupCollection: {name} will be able to remove every group of the collection, including those you added, while it is open to contributions. They will be notified by email if they turned it on.

privateClosed.wordGroup: While the group is closed to contributions, these people have no access to it. You can still choose their type of sharing: it will apply when you reopen the group.
privateClosed.groupCollection: While the collection is closed to contributions, these people have no access to it. You can still choose their type of sharing: it will apply when you reopen the collection.

publicClosed.wordGroup: While the group is closed to contributions, these people see it like everyone else, without contributing. Their type of sharing will apply if you reopen contributions to authorized people.
publicClosed.groupCollection: While the collection is closed to contributions, these people see it like everyone else, without contributing. Their type of sharing will apply if you reopen contributions to authorized people.

openToEveryone.wordGroup: The group is open to everyone’s contributions: these people contribute like everyone else, with a partial sharing. Their type of sharing will apply if you restrict contributions to authorized people again.
openToEveryone.groupCollection: The collection is open to everyone’s contributions: these people contribute like everyone else, with a partial sharing. Their type of sharing will apply if you restrict contributions to authorized people again.
